sources.title: IndicF5: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview IndicF5 is a near-human quality text-to-speech model for Indian languages, developed by ai4bharat. The model synthesizes speech by accepting three inputs: target text, a reference audio prompt, and the transcript of that reference audio. It learns prosody and speaker characteristics from the reference prompt to generate natural-sounding speech. Built on the F5-TTS architecture ...

sources.title: GitHub - hareeshbabu82ns/TTSIndicF5: TTS for Indic Languages
sources.snippet: We release IndicF5, a near-human polyglot Text-to-Speech (TTS) model trained on 1417 hours of high-quality speech from Rasa, IndicTTS, LIMMITS, and IndicVoices-R. IndicF5 supports 11 Indian languages: Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu.
